code:
ACTIVE MEMBER (v1):
subscription_status <> 'canceled'
AND (paused_since IS NULL OR paused_since > CURRENT_DATE - 30)
AND paid_through_date >= reporting_date
-- deduplicated to one row per member_id

ENGAGED MEMBER (v1, Marketing's original intent, renamed):
Active member AND >= 1 check-in/app session in trailing 30 days
caption: Two honestly-named metrics instead of one contested number.

code:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM dbo.memberships m
WHERE m.subscription_status <> 'canceled'
  AND (m.paused_since IS NULL
       OR m.paused_since > DATEADD(day, -30, @reporting_date))
  AND m.paid_through_date >= @reporting_date;
caption: Run by hand against 3 sample dates before anyone signs off.
